notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Satyr Hedonist by paying {R} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Wild Cantor by paying {R/G}.
Wild Cantor enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Satyr Hedonist from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing itself, adding {G}.
Cast Satyr Hedonist by paying {1}{G}.
Satyr Hedonist enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
